blocks.prompt: 3 The first term of an H.P. is \(-\frac{1}{3}\) and the fifth term is \(\frac{1}{5}\). Find its 9th term.
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein H.P. ki do terms di gayi hain, pehli aur paanchvin, aur teesri term (nauvin) poochhi gayi hai.
Reciprocals lein to A.P. mein \(a_1 = -3\) aur \(a_5 = 5\) ban jate hain.
Plan: in do se \(d\) nikalo, phir \(a_9\), phir ulta kar ke H.P. ki term.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: H.P. ki pehli term \(-\frac{1}{3}\), paanchvin term \(\frac{1}{5}\).
Humein find karna hai: H.P. ki 9th term.
Tareeqa: Reciprocals ki A.P. mein \(a_n = a_1 + (n - 1)d\) lagayenge. Jab A.P. ki koi bhi do terms maloom hon to \(d\) nikal aata hai, aur phir koi bhi term.

A.P. ki terms likhein
\[a_1 = -3, \quad a_5 = 5\]
Kyun: \(-\frac{1}{3}\) ko ulta karein to \(-3\) (sign wahi rehta hai), aur \(\frac{1}{5}\) ka ulta 5.

\(d\) nikalein
\[a_5 = a_1 + 4d\]
\[5 = -3 + 4d\]
\[4d = 8 \Rightarrow d = 2\]
Kyun: Pehli se paanchvin term tak 4 qadam hain. \(-3\) ko doosri taraf le gaye to \(5 + 3 = 8\).

A.P. ki 9th term
\[a_9 = a_1 + 8d\]
\[= -3 + 8(2) = 13\]
Kyun: 9th term pehli se 8 qadam aage hai. Is ko \(a_9 = a_5 + 4d = 5 + 8 = 13\) se bhi nikal sakte hain, yeh doosra raasta tasdeeq bhi hai.

Ulta karein
\[\text{H.P. ki 9th term} = \dfrac{1}{13}\]
Kyun: Hum ne A.P. mein kaam kiya tha, ab wapas H.P. mein aane ke liye reciprocal lena zaroori hai.
Dhyan dein: Jawab 13 likh dena aam ghalti hai; H.P. ki term \(\frac{1}{13}\) hai.
Tasdeeq: A.P. likhein: \(-3, -1, 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13\). Paanchvin jagah 5 hai jo diya hua tha, aur nauvin jagah 13. Answer key bhi \(\frac{1}{13}\) deti hai.
